parse_trace_dataframe: parse a Chrome trace JSON file into metadata, a pandas DataFrame of events, and a symbol table
parse_trace_dict: parse a raw trace JSON or gzipped file into a Python dictionary representation
infer_gpu_type: infer the GPU type (NVIDIA, AMD, MTIA) from trace metadata or a symbol name set
parse_metadata_ijson: extract trace metadata from a file handle using ijson without loading the full trace into memory
compress_df: compress a trace events DataFrame by dropping unused columns, extracting args, and downcasting dtypes
